perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: crossDivisionLeverage
factors.basis: Serve's August 17 announcement added Grubhub distribution, San Jose and Washington DC expansion, a Miami micro-depot, merchant hardware and advertising, while also introducing Moxi 2.0 hospital robotics.

risks: Breadth across delivery, hospital robotics, hardware and advertising increases integration and execution complexity.
unknowns: Incremental revenue and unit economics by new channel/product were not quantified in the announcement.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: executionQuality
factors.basis: The Grubhub launch was announced with concrete initial merchant counts: more than 100 participating merchants in Chicago and nearly 200 in Los Angeles.

risks: Merchant availability is not equivalent to order volume, utilization or profitable unit economics.
unknowns: Order density, contribution margin, utilization and customer retention for the new channel.

facts: Serve and Grubhub announced robot delivery beginning in Chicago, Los Angeles and Alexandria.
Announcement stated more than 100 participating Grubhub merchants in Chicago and nearly 200 in Los Angeles.
Serve also announced San Jose and Washington DC expansion, a Miami micro-depot, merchant hardware, advertising service and Moxi 2.0 hospital robot.

result: Fresh source-addressed execution/distribution evidence supplied; economics remain unresolved for Alpha.
